items.title: Sykehjemmet ble «friskmeldt» to ganger – nå avdekker interne rapporter svikt: – En skandale
items.excerpt: Sykehjemsetaten mener det ikke finnes noe dokumentasjon på at det systematisk serveres for lite mat. «Én pakke fiskepinner på 18 eldre» står det i et av avvikene.

items.title: Vučić concedes Serbian election, says Student List will be the largest party – Europe live
items.excerpt: The Student List movement is taking on authoritarian leader following nearly two years of protests against government and institutional corruption What is at stake in Serbia’s election? The latest turnout projection by Ipsos/Cesid suggests a turnout of 60.8% by 5pm local time (4pm UK), with three hours still to go until the polling stations close.

items.title: Wilson beats Jones to secure NI Open title
items.excerpt: Kyren Wilson wins his second Northern Ireland Open title in three years with a clinical 9-2 victory over Jak Jones at the Waterfront Hall.

items.title: Can Carrick survive Man United’s slump and Fernandes fallout?
items.excerpt: Manchester United cheer Michael Carrick off after Bournemouth loss but boo Bruno Fernandes, what now for crisis club?

items.title: Pressure intensifies on Carrick as Man Utd lose to Bournemouth
items.excerpt: Manchester United's winless run stretches to eight matches in all competitions as they're beaten 3-0 by Bournemouth at Old Trafford - a defeat that leaves United's manager Michael Carrick under severe pressure.

items.title: Liverpool earn first league win at Anfield with victory over Brighton
items.excerpt: An own goal from Brighton's Pascal Gross swiftly followed by a goal from Alexander Isak, sees Liverpool beat the Seagulls 2-0 at Anfield to move into the Premier League top four.
